behavior: The toggle is bound as chat:workflowKeywordToggle on meta+w and only acts when workflowsAvailable() and workflowKeywordTriggerEnabled both hold and the draft has non-empty Art(value) runs.
Dismissing suppresses the keyword highlight through composerHighlights' workflowKeyword gate, shows the source notice on the status row for 5000ms, and keeps the dismissal across further edits.
Pressing alt+w again clears the notice and restores the highlight.
Editing until the keyword runs disappear clears the dismissal and the notice, mirroring the source input subscription.
The two settings parse strictly, merge into the CLI config, reload live through bindConfigWatch, and reach the TUI through setWorkflowKeywordSettings.
